title: Light Conquers Darkness
musical: Rainbow Academy Musical - Magic School Adventure
description: Rainbow Academy Musical - Magic School Adventure | Plot: Climactic restoration of Rainbow Crystal and academy's protection | Emotion: Triumph of love and understanding over fear and division | Setting: The Heart Chamber - deepest part of Crystal Caves where Rainbow Crystal's power originates at Immediately following the team unity moment | Characters: Full Company - Luna, Ruby, Sage, Aurora, Obsidian, All unicorn partners including Shadowmere, Academy community (arriving to help)
lyrics:
LUNA:
Here in this sacred place
Where magic first began
We gather all together
To heal what we can

Light conquers darkness
Not by fighting it away
But by understanding
That we all have a part to play

OBSIDIAN:
I offer up my shadows
I offer up my pain
Transform them into wisdom
Let love break every chain

The darkness that I carried
For fifteen lonely years
Becomes the understanding
That dries another's tears

Light conquers darkness
When we choose to heal instead
Light conquers darkness
When love conquers dread

RUBY:
I offer up my need to be perfect

SAGE:
I offer up my need to be right

BOTH:
Together we are stronger
Together we shine bright

RUBY:
Your wisdom makes me better

SAGE:
Your courage helps me grow

BOTH:
Light conquers darkness
When we let our friendship show
character_notes:
